profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary: Web Developer with a history of solving problems for WordPress-based clients. Skilled in front-end development using HTML5, JavaScript, and React as well as back-end development utilizing LAMP stacks.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Utilizing WordPress, Custom Fields integration, dynamic PHP content and custom plugins to build small scale sites that are editable by clients. Additionally using JavaScript to create simple, seamless user interaction.

positions.title: Captioning Assistant
positions.description: Provided live captioning service for clients who use Captel phones.

positions.title: Indie Game Developer
positions.description: Collaborated with a partner on a number of creative and professional game projects. I primarily handled art assets (Photoshop and Blender) and coding (C#). I used both Unity (4 and 5) and Unreal and worked on 2D games as well as small 3D projects.

positions.title: Attractions
positions.description: Operated Flight of the Hippogriff coaster, acted as a wand assistant inside Ollivander's, and helped guests perform spells around Hogsmeade.
